/**
 * The five display modes (RSVP, Block, Guide, Karaoke, Subtitle), plus the
 * <TimedView> wrapper that subscribes to wavesurfer's timeupdate directly so
 * that the parent <Listen> page does NOT re-render on every audio frame.
 *
 * Word changes happen at speech rate (~3-5Hz), not 60Hz. The wrapper only
 * setStates when the active word index actually changes — keeping the
 * surrounding controls/settings/waveform stable.
 */
import { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { renderOrp } from "../lib/orp";
import type { DisplayMode } from "./SettingsPanel";

export type AlignedWord = {
  word: string;
  start: number | null;
  end: number | null;
  source: string;
  para: number | null;
};

export function findActiveIndex(words: AlignedWord[], t: number): number {
  let lo = 0, hi = words.length - 1;
  while (lo <= hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    const w = words[mid];
    if ((w.start ?? Infinity) > t) hi = mid - 1;
    else if ((w.end ?? -Infinity) <= t) lo = mid + 1;
    else return mid;
  }
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(words.length - 1, lo - 1));
}

/** Subscribes to the audio element's timeupdate and only re-renders when the
 *  active word index changes. HTMLAudioElement's timeupdate fires ~4Hz which
 *  is plenty for word-level sync (~5Hz speech rate). */
export function TimedView({ audio, words, mode }: { audio: HTMLAudioElement | null; words: AlignedWord[]; mode: DisplayMode }) {
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!audio) return;
    const onTime = () => {
      const ni = findActiveIndex(words, audio.currentTime);
      setIdx((prev) => (prev === ni ? prev : ni));
    };
    audio.addEventListener("timeupdate", onTime);
    onTime(); // initial sync
    return () => audio.removeEventListener("timeupdate", onTime);
  }, [audio, words]);

  switch (mode) {
    case "rsvp":     return <RsvpView    words={words} idx={idx} />;
    case "block":    return <BlockView   words={words} idx={idx} />;
    case "guide":    return <GuideView   words={words} idx={idx} />;
    case "karaoke":  return <KaraokeView words={words} idx={idx} />;
    case "subtitle": return <SubtitleView words={words} idx={idx} />;
  }
}

type ViewProps = { words: AlignedWord[]; idx: number };

// ---------- RSVP ----------
export const RsvpView = memo(function RsvpView({ words, idx }: ViewProps) {
  const w = words[idx]?.word ?? "";
  const { before, orp, after } = renderOrp(w);
  return (
    <div className="rsvp">
      <span>{before}</span>
      <span className="orp-letter">{orp}</span>
      <span>{after}</span>
    </div>
  );
});

// ---------- Block (full chapter text) ----------
// Full chapter view with auto-scroll-to-current. Auto-scroll *suspends*
// when the user manually scrolls — they can read backwards or skim ahead
// without the page yanking back. Auto-scroll resumes after 5s of no
// manual scroll, OR if the user scrolls back near the active word.
export const BlockView = memo(function BlockView({ words, idx }: ViewProps) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const currentRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const userScrolledAt = useRef<number>(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    let isProgrammatic = false;
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (isProgrammatic) { isProgrammatic = false; return; }
      userScrolledAt.current = performance.now();
    };
    el.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });

    // Auto-scroll attempt (will be suppressed if user scrolled recently)
    const sinceScroll = performance.now() - userScrolledAt.current;
    if (sinceScroll > 5000 || userScrolledAt.current === 0) {
      isProgrammatic = true;
      currentRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
    }
    return () => el.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
  }, [idx]);

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="block-text scrollable">
      {words.map((w, i) => (
        <span key={i} ref={i === idx ? currentRef : null}>
          {w.word}{" "}
          {i > 0 && words[i].para !== words[i - 1].para ? <><br /><br /></> : null}
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
});

// ---------- Cue-based views (Subtitle / Guide / Karaoke) ----------
// All three show only the *current SRT-like cue* (1–2 sentences, large,
// centred). They differ in how they treat the active word inside the cue:
//   - subtitle: no per-word marker
//   - guide:    thin red underline under the active word
//   - karaoke:  active word is bold + slightly larger; past = full opacity,
//               future = 60% opacity

type Cue = { firstIdx: number; lastIdx: number; words: AlignedWord[] };

function buildCues(words: AlignedWord[]): Cue[] {
  const out: Cue[] = [];
  let bufStart = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
    const lastChar = words[i].word.slice(-1);
    const len = i - bufStart + 1;
    if (len >= 8 && (".?!".includes(lastChar) || len >= 14)) {
      out.push({ firstIdx: bufStart, lastIdx: i, words: words.slice(bufStart, i + 1) });
      bufStart = i + 1;
    }
  }
  if (bufStart < words.length) {
    out.push({ firstIdx: bufStart, lastIdx: words.length - 1, words: words.slice(bufStart) });
  }
  return out;
}

function findCue(cues: Cue[], idx: number): Cue | undefined {
  for (const c of cues) if (c.firstIdx <= idx && idx <= c.lastIdx) return c;
  return cues[0];
}

export const SubtitleView = memo(function SubtitleView({ words, idx }: ViewProps) {
  const cues = useMemo(() => buildCues(words), [words]);
  const cue = findCue(cues, idx);
  return <div className="subtitle">{cue?.words.map((w) => w.word).join(" ") ?? ""}</div>;
});

export const GuideView = memo(function GuideView({ words, idx }: ViewProps) {
  const cues = useMemo(() => buildCues(words), [words]);
  const cue = findCue(cues, idx);
  if (!cue) return null;
  return (
    <div className="subtitle guide">
      {cue.words.map((w, i) => {
        const absIdx = cue.firstIdx + i;
        const isCurrent = absIdx === idx;
        return (
          <span key={i} className={isCurrent ? "word current" : "word"}>{w.word}{i < cue.words.length - 1 ? " " : ""}</span>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});

export const KaraokeView = memo(function KaraokeView({ words, idx }: ViewProps) {
  const cues = useMemo(() => buildCues(words), [words]);
  const cue = findCue(cues, idx);
  if (!cue) return null;
  return (
    <div className="subtitle karaoke">
      {cue.words.map((w, i) => {
        const absIdx = cue.firstIdx + i;
        const isCurrent = absIdx === idx;
        const isFuture = absIdx > idx;
        const cls = isCurrent ? "word current" : isFuture ? "word future" : "word";
        return (
          <span key={i} className={cls}>{w.word}{i < cue.words.length - 1 ? " " : ""}</span>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});
